stem:
Chitra's school building is 20 m tall. A classroom door in the same building is about 2 m tall. She wants to make sense of the 20 m height.

Which comparison is appropriate?

options.text: Read only the printed 20 and skip naming any familiar object for comparison.
Decide from place-value naming of the digits in 20 alone, without a familiar height.
Compare with the door: the building is about 10 door-heights, or 18 m taller than the door.
Choose 20 because it is the largest printed number in the stem.

teacher.key_rationale: A large measurement is understood by a difference or a multiple relative to a familiar object in the same unit. Skipping the familiar reference omits the comparison. Place-value naming alone is a different hinge. Picking the largest printed numeral is surface capture.

mx_swap.reason: Quick-factor multiplication CWO invents a speed-arithmetic hinge not in the stem; kept condition_omission, scope_error, surface_feature_capture on familiar-reference comparison.
